about.softwareIntroText: Fuyun Tools is a Windows productivity toolkit integrating clipboard management, screenshot, recording, text selection translation, and document management. Built with Tauri, it is lightweight and efficient, helping you boost daily productivity.
about.feature1: Text Clipboard - Auto-record history with search, categories, and hotkey paste-back
about.feature2: Image Clipboard - Thumbnail list, double-click paste-back, and full-size preview
about.feature3: History Limit Policy - Configurable "Only limit ungrouped items" to protect grouped content
about.feature4: Text Selection Assistant - Translate/Explain/Copy selected text on Windows
about.feature5: Screenshot & OCR - Quick screenshot on Windows, OCR recognition in pinned image window
about.feature6: AI Configuration - OpenAI-compatible services, custom providers & locally encrypted key storage
about.usage1: Text Clipboard: Press Ctrl+Shift+Z to open text history window
about.usage2: Image Clipboard: Press Ctrl+Shift+X to open image history window
about.usage3: Screenshot: Press Ctrl+Shift+S to open screenshot window
about.usage4: Image OCR: Right-click in pinned image window, select OCR to view text results
about.usage5: Image Paste-back: Double-click target item in image window to copy and paste to focused app
about.usage6: Selection Feature: Auto-shows toolbar when text is selected on Windows
about.usage7: Limit Policy: Enable "Only limit ungrouped items" in Settings > Clipboard
about.usage8: System Tray: Right-click tray icon for settings, auto-start toggle, log operations (debug mode), and exit
about.ffmpegNotice:
This software integrates FFmpeg for audio/video processing. FFmpeg is licensed under LGPL/GPL.
FFmpeg is invoked as a separate executable process; no static linking.
